_comment: The registry ui/server.py reads. Without it, discovery falls back to newest-file, which picks whatever was copied last -- including the temporal refiner, which is not an SDR2HDRNet and will not load as one.

models.title: v5 + shadow gate (shipped)
models.note: The model the paper reports. Seed 20260901. Positive on all four measures.

models.title: shadow gate, seed 2
models.note: Best of the three on clean PU21 (+0.71 dB), worst on clean CVVDP.

models.title: shadow gate, seed 3
models.note: The middle seed on every measure.

models.title: v5 backbone, no gate
models.note: What shipped before the gate. -3.0 dB on clean, +1.43 on degraded.

models.title: v6, 4x capacity
models.note: The capacity ablation. 64 base channels. Moved neither condition much.

models.title: temporal refiner
models.note: NOT an SDR2HDRNet -- the viewer must not try to load it. Unevaluated: 4 val and 5 test clips of one scene each.
